title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game
facts: Pre-orders for the video game Grand Theft Auto 6 opened globally at midnight on June 25.
Industry analysts estimate that the development costs for Grand Theft Auto 6 exceed $1 billion.
Rockstar Games scheduled the official release of Grand Theft Auto 6 for November 19.
Grand Theft Auto 6 was previously delayed from target release windows in autumn 2025 and May 2026.
Players who pre-order Grand Theft Auto 6 will be permitted to pre-load the game starting November 12.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled for launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S consoles.
The standard edition of Grand Theft Auto 6 is priced at £69.99 in the United Kingdom and $79.99 in the United States.
Physical retail copies of Grand Theft Auto 6 will contain a digital download code inside the box instead of a game disc.
Grand Theft Auto 6 introduces the series' first playable 3D female protagonist named Lucia alongside a male lead named Jason.
The fictional setting for Grand Theft Auto 6 is the state of Leonida, based on Florida.
The fictional city of Vice City, based on Miami, serves as the primary urban center in Grand Theft Auto 6.
Grand Theft Auto 5 has sold nearly 230 million copies worldwide since its original September 2013 launch.
Rockstar Games first officially confirmed active development on the next Grand Theft Auto title in February 2022.
Former employees at the Rockstar North studio in Edinburgh accused the company of union-busting practices.
The first two gameplay trailers for Grand Theft Auto 6 have accumulated roughly 447 million combined views.
